info.title: myTransics TX-SERVICE API
info.description:
API surface of **TX-SERVICE** (`https://www.mytransics.com/service`), the Transics device/company configuration app that the `/service` URL opens after login.

## How this spec was built
- Logged in with the provided test account (no 2FA or captcha).
- Captured the live XHR/JSONP traffic of the landing dashboard.
- Parsed every `endpointId` + `path` request definition in `txservice.min.js` (app version 1.26.214-30) and the identity shell `app.js`.
- **Write operations were discovered from the frontend only and were not executed** (no create/update/delete/submit except the login the account holder asked for).
- Personal data (tokens, emails, IMEI/IMSI, plates, APN secrets, user ids) is redacted from examples.
- Learned operations were kept local. Nothing from this authenticated site was published to the api-anything shared catalog.

## Authentication
1. `POST /api/login` with `{ username, password }`, `Content-Type: text/plain`, cookies (`withCredentials`).
2. Browser follows `/service/login/{token}`, which sets an HttpOnly cookie `token` (path `/service`) plus a `session` cookie.
3. `GET /service/environment.js` (cookie-authenticated) returns `user.token`. That value is the API bearer for SKYCC / DWH / AWS sync / myTransics v2.
4. **GET (JSONP):** `{base}{path}?callback=_jqjsp&token={user.token}&params={json}` where `params` is the request object (fields, constraints, filters, sort, search, query, `_id`).
5. **POST:** `POST {base}{path}` with `Content-Type: text/plain`, body `JSON.stringify({ ...request, token })`, `withCredentials: true`.
6. A JSON response with `code: 401` sends the UI back to login.

The `params` / body `token` is **not** the same string as the `/service` cookie in all cases; use `user.token` from `environment.js`.

## Servers (from environment.js `requestHandler.endpoints`)
- `skycc` — https://ww4sb.tx-connect.com/SKYCC/api/v1/ (main app API)
- `mytransics` / `txmytransics` — https://www.mytransics.com/api/v2/
- `dwh` — https://dwhrestapi.transics.com/api/v1/
- `awssync` — https://www.mytransics.com/awssync/v1/
- Identity portal — https://www.mytransics.com/api/

## Tested live
Identity: `GET /api/statuscheck`, `POST /api/login`, `GET /config.json`, `GET /languages/resources_en.json`, `GET /service/login/{token}`, `GET /service/environment.js`.

SKYCC reads on the default dashboard: `/customers`, `/customers/genericsettings`, `/customers/profilesettings`, `/devices`, `/diagnostic/info`, `/devices/sensors/GetAll`, `/remoteupdate`, `/devices/settings`.

All other operations are documented from the frontend and marked as not tested.
